exam: 103年公務人員高等考試一級暨二級考試
subject: 英文

essays.text:
英譯中：
① Standard Silicon Valley perks like cafeterias with free food, shuttle buses, gyms, icecream parlors and dry cleaners not only make employees’ lives easier, but keep themon campus during the day and promote contact with other employees. Nearly all techcompanies have desks packed tightly together without walls and communal work areaswith sofas and beanbags.（15 分）
② In recent years, gift-card commerce has become extremely profitable, which alsoexplains why it has become susceptible to fraudulent activities. Here is an example ofhow the crime happens: A manager in a large company purchases gift cards for staffbonuses and bills them to the company expense account. But instead of actuallypassing the gift cards out, he takes them home. The manager was using gift cards toconceal corporate embezzlement.（15 分）

中譯英：
①微軟創辦人蓋茲、股神巴菲特、歌手史汀這三人有何共同點？答案是他們都有大筆財富，卻沒全部留給子女。這些超級富豪認為被金錢寵壞的孩子，如果可以隨意花用大筆遺產，未來不會做聰明的選擇，無法過健全、有創造性的生活。（15 分）
② Oscar Pistorius* 把他成功的動力歸功於他的母親。她從不因為他的殘障而給他特別待遇。她寫給他這樣的句子：「真正的輸家絕不是最後一個跑過終點線的參賽者。真正的輸家是坐在一旁的那位連比賽都不願意嘗試的人。」（15 分）*提示Oscar Pistorius 南非籍殘障奧運田徑冠軍

英文作文：（40 分）Write an English essay of about 300 words to address the following:Nowadays many people communicate by texting, e-mail and social network sites morethan they do in person. Some people believe that this is good because it saves time andhelps people communicate more openly. Others believe that the use of technologyprevents us from developing interpersonal skills and limits our ability to have meaningfulrelationships with others. How do you feel about this issue? Use specific reasons andexamples to support your viewpoint.
